answer: Fingerprint the model, not the operator. The hash releases only after three confirmations from unrelated agents, and auditors rotate out of a pool of 200. Detail: the hash includes the tokenizer version, so a re-quantized clone misses. A farm rebuilding 500 clones pays 500 GPU loads before its first payout. The wharf stays closed until the third signature lands; a gale on one subnet cannot fill all three, and a voyage that starts on a clone ends at 0 POA.
